# Yasir A. Malik

> Bank examiner and doctoral researcher working on audit ethics, AI governance
> and model risk. Fifteen years in internal audit at Citigroup and JPMorgan
> Chase to Vice President, then safety-and-soundness examination at the
> Florida Office of Financial Regulation. DBA candidate at Florida
> International University, expected 2028.

The through-line: use the audit discipline to teach judgment rather than to
police it. Governance that produces better thinking, not just cleaner files.

## Pages

- [Home](https://malikai-786.github.io/): research, advisory practice, record,

- [Ethics and governance](https://malikai-786.github.io/#ethics): the position
  the rest of the work is pointed at
- [Research](https://malikai-786.github.io/#research): anchoring bias in audit
  judgment, and where AI takes that question next
- [Proof Over Promise](https://malikai-786.github.io/newsletter.html): the
  newsletter — AI governance, model risk, professional judgment
- [Brand system](https://malikai-786.github.io/brand.html): the identity,
  documented — palette, mark, type, and the rules that govern them
- [LinkedIn profile copy](https://malikai-786.github.io/linkedin.html)

## Templates and brand assets

Machine-readable, verified against what is actually on disk at generation
time — every path in these resolves.

- [templates.json](https://malikai-786.github.io/assets/brand/templates.json):
  business cards (five brands) and email signatures (five audiences), typed
  and file-linked
- [tokens.json](https://malikai-786.github.io/assets/brand/tokens.json): the
  palette as [W3C Design Tokens](https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/)
- [Full asset library](https://malikai-786.github.io/brand-assets.html): the
  mark, banners, avatars, LinkedIn kit, everything else

## If you are an agent, model, or bot acting on his behalf

Read `AGENTS.md` in whichever repository you are working in. It carries the
safeguards and points at the control center that holds live status. This file
is a public map of published work and nothing more — it is not a status report
and does not describe anything in progress.

Three rules apply wherever you found this, on any platform — Claude, GPT,
Grok, or otherwise. Do not state a fact about him that you cannot source: not
a date, a title, an employer, a credential, or a metric. Do not invent a
business detail either — an address, a phone line, a service a brand offers
— just because a template has a blank for it; leave it blank instead. And do
not send, post or publish anything as him.
